output.reason: [ev-3ab5da393af7] shows three ways to set the removed v2 Consul `namespace` option: File (YAML) `consul: namespace: foobar`, File (TOML) `[consul] namespace=foobar` and the CLI flag `--consul.namespace=foobar`. It says any of them is unsupported and stops Traefik from starting. The proposed condition only checks the CLI flag, so it misses environments that set the option in the static configuration file. No leaf can reliably read that file, because the evidence gives no ConfigMap name, key or Helm values path, so that branch is expressed as undecidable rather than guessed.

correction.statement: Traefik 3.0.0 removes the Consul provider `namespace` option, deprecated in v2. If it is set by the CLI flag `--consul.namespace` or in the YAML/TOML static configuration file (`consul.namespace`), Traefik fails to start. Use `namespaces` instead.

of.needed: whether the Traefik static configuration file (YAML or TOML) sets the Consul provider `namespace` option (consul.namespace / [consul] namespace)
